items.title: KR Client E8/000F outbound authentication creates a Server receive requirement candidate
items.requirement: An independently designed Server needs to consider how to receive and parse two different Client-local C2S auth variants, E8/112B on mode52 versus 000F/214B on mode54/other, where the builder queues via key1.
unknowns: No observed complete real wire transaction
E8 +104..109 has no direct initializing writer in inspected builder; do not assign a fixed value
Official authentication policy and startup mode selection remain unknown

items.title: Conditional LOGIN 0x0013/0x007A handlers expose possible Server send shapes
items.requirement: Server may need to produce a valid S2C application 0x0013 or separate 0x007A for the appropriate LOGIN scene/state: 0x13 status+0x16, groupCount+0x1C/cursor+0x92; 0x7A groupCount+2/cursor+6.
unknowns: Handler registration does not prove original Server sent these messages or their order
Status enum, full length, packet framing, socket and C2S pairing unknown

items.title: Frame handling and scene delivery constraints for Server-sent responses
items.requirement: If sending frames to original Client, the independent Server design must respect frame parsing, length, checksum/decode and lane2/scene reachability gates. Invalid checksum or inflate can suppress app delivery.
unknowns: Which frame marker is sent first in an original session
Original Server retry policy and complete receive sequence

items.title: Independent Server should restore playable login, character selection and entry to gameplay
items.requirement: The explicitly stated project goal is restoring a playable flow while keeping Server design and code implementation in different repositories. This feature request does not prove original Server wire behavior.
